init.title: PumpSteer – configure
init.description: Select temperature and price sources. Expand only the sections you need. Existing values are retained in collapsed sections; changes apply only when you save.

temperature_sources.name: Additional temperature sensors and freshness
temperature_sources.description: Optional. Weights are normalised automatically. The backup outdoor source is used when the primary is unusable. HA report time does not prove physical measurement time. An overly short age limit may trigger SAFE.

data.indoor_temp_weight_1: Weight for the primary indoor sensor (from basic settings)

data_description.outdoor_temperature_report_max_age_minut: Default 120 minutes, based on observed reporting gaps. Adjust for your outdoor sensors. HA report time does not prove physical measurement time.
data_description.temperature_report_max_age_minutes: The default is 360 minutes, based on observed reporting intervals. Adjust it to your sensors’ observed intervals. HA report time does not establish physical measurement time.

outputs.name: Outputs – Ohmigo and Generic Output
outputs.description: Keep working connections unchanged. Ohmigo and Generic Output are independently configured. The relay selection is used by Relay Guard.

data_description.modbus_interval_minutes: Minimum time between Generic Output System service calls.
data_description.modbus_payload_template: YAML payload template for the service call. The template can use the fake_temp variable.
data_description.modbus_service: Home Assistant service to call, for example modbus.write_register, mqtt.publish or input_number.set_value.
data_description.ohmigo_entity: PumpSteer will push the fake outdoor temperature to this number entity after each update. Leave empty to disable. Toggle without reconfiguring using the 'Ohmigo Push' switch.
data_description.ohmigo_interval_minutes: Minimum time between pushes to Ohmigo. Default 5 minutes. Changes below 0.2 °C are treated as unchanged, but the current setpoint is resent when the interval is due to keep the Ohmigo watchdog alive.
data_description.ohmigo_relay_entity: Optional switch entity for the Ohmigo Active/Bypass relay. When configured, PumpSteer exposes a separate Relay Guard switch. The guard only recovers an explicit OFF state while Ohmigo Push is ON; unknown or unavailable states never cause a relay command.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: Price notifications and zone alerts have separate recipients. An empty zone recipient inherits the shared zone recipient, not the price notification recipient.

data_description.notification_cooldown_minutes: Minimum time between repeated alerts of the same type. Choose 0 for no limit; 60 minutes is recommended. Braking and preheating have independent timers.
data_description.notification_level: Choose all price alerts, braking only, or none. The existing Notifications switch remains the master on/off control.
data_description.notify_service: Leave empty to use persistent notifications in the HA sidebar instead.

zone_1.name: Additional temperature zone 1
zone_1.description: Monitoring only, even with alerts enabled. The zone does not change a thermostat setpoint or valve opening and does not control central heat production. A cold zone does not affect the shared PI controller.

data_description.zone_1_alarm_delay_minutes: Default 15 minutes, configurable from 1 to 240. A low-temperature alert requires at least two separate below-threshold reports spanning the delay. Other alerts have their own evidence requirements.
data_description.zone_1_climate: Optional and read-only. Room temperature monitoring still works without a thermostat, but thermostat diagnostics and heat-shortage analysis are limited. Its setpoint is not the zone alarm threshold.
data_description.zone_1_comfort_threshold: Temperature threshold for Comfort. Default 18 °C. Used only when this profile is selected.
data_description.zone_1_enabled: Off by default. When enabled, the zone can alert on low temperature, a forecast, suspected heat shortage and sensor faults. Temperature remains monitored with alerts off.
data_description.zone_1_entity: Choose a room temperature sensor in °C. A sensor near a radiator can read differently from the room.
data_description.zone_1_name: The name appears in diagnostics and zone notifications.
data_description.zone_1_notify_service: Optional override. Empty uses the shared zone recipient; if that is also empty no push is sent.
data_description.zone_1_profile: Choose manually which of the two zone temperature thresholds is used.
data_description.zone_1_threshold: Temperature threshold for Maintenance heat. Default 5 °C. Used only when this profile is selected.

thermal.name: Thermal Intelligence and adaptive braking
thermal.description: Passive collection and adaptive control are separate features. For a passive trial enable Thermal Intelligence and leave adaptive braking off. Expanding this section does not enable anything.

data.external_heat_sources: Do you sometimes use an additional heat source?

data_description.adaptive_braking_enabled: Separate permission for legacy adaptive control. Leave off for a passive field trial. Evidence collection does not enable this setting.
data_description.external_heat_sources: Yes means extra heat may sometimes occur, not that it is on now. Adaptive braking can learn from stable temperature response, rejects clearly disturbed periods and needs later independent checks. Undetected extra heat remains a possible confound; this does not measure heat flow.
data_description.thermal_intelligence_enabled: Collects observations and evaluates a passive model candidate. Does not by itself permit adaptive control or prove forecast skill.

heat_pump_data.name: Heat pump signals and energy metering
heat_pump_data.description: Optional signals for diagnostics and heating-operation evidence. Compressor activity, electrical power and sent commands do not prove delivered space heat. Leave unused fields empty.

data.thermal_alarm_numeric_verified: I verified the numeric fault meaning
data.thermal_heat_activity_entity: Verified heat delivery to the home (optional)

data_description.thermal_alarm_entity: Choose a binary or numeric fault signal. A numeric signal stays inactive until you verify its normal value and that every other finite value means an active fault. Notifications use the regular recipient or a persistent HA notification.
data_description.thermal_alarm_numeric_normal: For a numeric sensor only: enter the verified normal value. Use 0 only if your heat pump documentation confirms it. Empty means an unknown fault state.
data_description.thermal_alarm_numeric_verified: For a numeric sensor only: confirm that the chosen value is normal and every other finite value means an active fault. A changed sensor or normal value requires confirmation again.
data_description.thermal_aux_heat_entity: Binary signal for active auxiliary electric heat.
data_description.thermal_balance_entity: Select a numeric sensor if available. No scale or sign convention is assumed.
data_description.thermal_balance_kind: Choose degree minutes or integral only when the meaning is verified; otherwise choose raw value. No start threshold is assumed.
data_description.thermal_brine_pump_entity: Binary brine pump status. This alone does not prove heat delivery.
data_description.thermal_circulation_pump_entity: Binary heating circulation pump status. This alone does not prove heat delivery.
data_description.thermal_compressor_entity: Compressor status alone does not prove radiator heating.
data_description.thermal_detection_method: Automatic uses qualified signals and reports uncertainty. Manual retains the supply threshold.
data_description.thermal_energy_entities: Select one total meter or independent meters that can be summed. Selected meters take precedence for energy diagnostics. Only complete counter intervals with one unambiguous price are priced. Report gaps above 24 hours are excluded.
data_description.thermal_external_heat_entity: Leave empty without a reliable signal. On must mean the external heater is actually active, not the heat pump compressor or a thermostat request. Requires a documented verified source observation time in the control timestamp attribute (default measurement_time), at most five minutes old. HA report time or MQTT republication is insufficient. Active or unknown selected signals pause adaptive use and require new checks; temperature monitoring works without this sensor.
data_description.thermal_heat_activity_entity: A binary sensor whose on means measured heat delivery to the home and off means none. Compressor status or hot-water mode alone is insufficient. Report times do not establish physical measurement time.
data_description.thermal_heating_mode_entity: Verified radiator mode is required for the manual supply indicator, but not for passive temperature observation.
data_description.thermal_heating_mode_inverted: Enable only when off means radiator mode. Unknown or stale status suspends learning.
data_description.thermal_hot_water_mode_entity: On means verified hot-water operation. Heat learning pauses when on or unknown; unknown periods are not classified.
data_description.thermal_power_entity: Measured electrical input for the equipment being analysed. Energy is estimated from HA reports; it is not delivered heat.
data_description.thermal_return_temp_entity: Used only together with other qualified signals.
data_description.thermal_supply_target_entity: The heat pump supply temperature target, not a room temperature or alarm threshold.
data_description.thermal_supply_temp_entity: Choose a radiator-circuit sensor. It can be observed passively without a radiator mode signal. Temperature does not prove heat delivery.
data_description.thermal_supply_threshold: Set for your heating system. An unsuitable threshold can misclassify heat.

advanced_control.name: Advanced control functions
advanced_control.description: These features can affect control. Keep existing choices unless signal meaning and measurement time have been verified. Changing a source or calibration revokes its previous safety verification.

data.control_aux_preheat_limit: Limit extra preheating during auxiliary heat
data.control_balance_brake_limit: Limit price braking using verified heat balance
data.control_balance_verified: I have verified normalization and deficit limits
data.control_signals_verified: I have verified signal meanings and observation times

data_description.control_aux_preheat_limit: Off by default. Removes only the extra preheat boost when auxiliary heat is verified active for radiator heating. Does not change the pump’s auxiliary or emergency heating and does not guarantee energy savings.
data_description.control_balance_brake_limit: Changes only existing price braking, not PI or the heat pump’s own controller. A deficit does not prove current heat delivery. Old data is not used; the output returns toward Base using the existing ramp times.
data_description.control_balance_deficit_full: Must exceed the first limit. Between the limits braking is released gradually; at and above this limit at most 50 percent is released.
data_description.control_balance_deficit_threshold: A verified positive limit in normalized units. Braking is unchanged at and below this limit.
data_description.control_balance_offset: Enter explicitly even if the verified offset is zero. Uses the same unit as the normalized deficit.
data_description.control_balance_scale: No guessed default. Must be finite and nonzero; may be negative according to the verified sign convention.
data_description.control_balance_verified: Confirm only with verified evidence for your sensor and heat pump. No decoding or universal sign convention is assumed automatically.
data_description.control_measurement_time_attribute: The same attribute is read from every participating sensor. Its value must be a verified observation time as a timezone-aware ISO timestamp or Unix seconds. Without reliable source evidence the intervention cannot activate; do not copy HA report time into another attribute.
data_description.control_signals_verified: Confirm only after verifying signal meanings and observation times. The time must be a physical measurement time or the receipt time of a new measurement message whose link to that specific value is verified by the source documentation. Receipt time is not physical measurement time. HA last_reported, MQTT republication and online status are not sufficient by themselves. Applies to both limiters.

error.heat_signal_alias: The heat signal must be a separate radiator heat indicator.
error.invalid_balance_kind: Choose a valid heat balance type.
error.control_signals_required: Select the required operation sensors and verify their meanings and observation timestamp attribute. A shared changeover valve requires verified inversion of the radiator mode.
error.control_balance_required: Select a heat balance sensor and verify normalization. Scale must be nonzero, offset explicit, and 0 < first limit < maximum limit.
error.invalid_numeric_alarm: Enter a valid numeric normal value before confirming its meaning.
error.external_heat_alias: External heat needs its own activity signal, not the heat pump compressor, auxiliary heat or operating-mode signal.
